_comment: The API seam. fetch-quotes-shioaji.py writes this shape into ~/.claude/stock-band/<project-slug>/stock-quotes.json (the runtime dir - see the README), which wins while fresh; hand-writing <project>/.claude/stock-quotes.json in this same shape is the manual override seam for any other fetcher. Older than 120s and it is ignored (the band falls back to demo prices). `market` and `asOf` are informational - the band still picks the market off the clock.
_comment_series: `series` = recent closes, oldest first, for the row's sparkline (20 points is plenty). `bars` = K bars, oldest first, as [open, high, low, close, volume?, ts?] (ts = bucket start in ms; without it the chart keeps the session axis) or {o,h,l,c,v?,ts?}, for the trend view; up to 120 are kept and the newest that fit are drawn. A futures file may add `barsBy: {"1": [...], "5": [...], "15": [...], "60": [...]}` for the timeframe buttons. With bars but no series, the sparkline uses the bars' closes. `barLabel` is what the title calls them, since only the feed knows the interval.
